title: `encoding/json`: marshal, unmarshal, tags and optional fields

videos.script: Lesson 18 left you with bytes in files. This lesson gives them a shape. {{marshal}} First, writing. You describe an order once, as a struct, and tags give each field its name in the JSON. An empty note disappears. A field with a small first letter never appears at all. {{decode}} Then reading, which is where the surprises are. A key with the wrong capitals still fills the field. A key nobody expected is dropped without a word. One switch turns that silence into an error. {{optional}} Next, the hard case: telling zero from nothing. A stock of zero and a stock nobody mentioned are different requests. A pointer tells them apart on the way in, and omitzero on the way out. {{v2}} Last, the newer version of the package that ships beside it, and two defaults it changed. {{close}} Lesson 20 is about time.
